name: Ctrl Swap
author: HANCORE
description: Swap CapsLock and Left Ctrl at the XKB level with a top-bar toggle. Non-invasive: applied at runtime via hyprctl, never writes config files, fully reversible.

barWidget.description: Toggle CapsLock ↔ Left Ctrl swap from the top bar. Runtime-only XKB option, restored when toggled off.
